title: Api ticket close
description: The body of POST /api/tickets/{ticket_id}/close, the one write a technician performs. The field is `verdict`, never `outcome`: fixtures/api-ticket-close/invalid-outcome.json pins that, so the schema, the frontend's fake backend and the real route cannot drift apart silently. The route answers with the resulting ticket message; the ticket id comes from the path and is not repeated in the body.

verdict.description: Whether the diagnosis on the ticket matched what the technician found.

note.description: What the technician found, in their own words.

closed_by.description: Who closed the ticket; a role or a shift name, not a personal identifier.
